competitor_advantages.point: Incept AI claims over 97% AI-only order completion for drive-thru and phone orders, versus an industry average it cites as 83%.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Incept AI is an early-stage (founded 2024) voice-AI vendor targeting drive-thru and phone ordering accuracy, integrated with Toast POS.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes directly with Genius's kitchen_drive_thru voice-ordering capabilities; currently POS-agnostic via a live Toast integration, which signals intent to plug into any operator's existing POS stack rather than requiring a POS swap.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Still small and recently funded ($3M pre-seed, Feb 2025); no disclosed Series A yet as of research date.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Ask prospects using or evaluating Incept AI what POS they run it against and what error/escalation rate they're seeing versus vendor-claimed 97% AI-only completion.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers were found in public sources; all performance stats are vendor-supplied and not independently verified. Company size and true market penetration are unclear at this early funding stage.
